locations.label: Centrifuge Syringe
locations.description: Pick up the syringe from the centrifuge in T1 Mutant Research Lab. Required for blood collection.

locations.label: Floating Zombie Blood Sample
locations.description: Jump into the Particle Accelerator Beam in T2 Sublevel 10 to knock down the floating zombie, then use the syringe to collect its blood.

locations.label: Fowler Mutant Injection
locations.description: Return syringe to centrifuge to spawn a Fowler Mangler. Kill it to obtain the Fowler Mutant Injection.

locations.label: DNA Vial
locations.description: After activating Pack-a-Punch, kill the "Geneticist Zombie" in T1 Mutant Research Lab for a keycard.Use the keycard to open the fridge and collect the DNA Vial. Required for final encounter.

locations.label: Bio Scanner Door
locations.description: Use the Fowler Mutant Injection at the scanner in T2 Dark Entity Containment to open portal to Teleportation Lab.

locations.label: Klaus Arms
locations.description: Android Assembly reference area only. Shoot the arms off Kommando Klaus enemies during their special rounds and collect both quest arms; they have no fixed map spawn.

locations.label: Klaus Legs - Shelf
locations.description:
Found in various locations within T2 Android Assembly.
1 of 4 possible spawn locations for Klaus legs in T2 Android Assembly. On a shelf near the assembly line.
locations.conditions: Possible location; the active spawn or chosen site depends on the current run.

locations.description:

locations.conditions: Possible location; the active spawn or chosen site depends on the current run.

locations.label: Hanging Klaus Assembly
locations.description:
Assembled Klaus robot used for hacking terminals during the main quest.
Place arms and legs on the Hanging Klaus in T2 Android Assembly, then get an Uber Klaus to shock it.

locations.label: Klaus First Terminal
locations.description: After activation, Franken-Klaus will work on this terminal. Progress a full round for him to move.

locations.label: S.A.M. Trial - Dark Entity Containment
locations.description: Complete the S.A.M. Trial (kill quota) that Klaus activates in T2 Dark Entity Containment.

locations.label: Klaus Final Terminal
locations.description: Klaus moves to T2 Teleportation Lab to work on the final terminal. Need 4-digit code to complete.

locations.label: S.A.M File - Executive Suite Table

locations.description: Enter periodic element code at keypad to access T1 Bioweapons Lab.

locations.description: Enter periodic element code at keypad to access T1 Bioweapons Lab.

locations.label: Gorgofex - Cyst
locations.description: Kill 3 Vermin then 3 zombies near the cyst container in T1 Bioweapons Lab to charge it.

locations.label: Aetheric Flora
locations.description: 1 of 3 glowing Aetheric Flora. Stand underneath to charge the cyst.

locations.label: Power Surge Computer
locations.description: One of the power surge computers in Dark Entity Containment. The source locates this computer only; consult the guide and room for the other terminals before beginning the timed sequence.

locations.label: Forsaken Transfer Panel
locations.description: Charged panel in front of Forsaken. Lure weakened Uber Klaus here to start the Forsaken mini-bossfight.

locations.label: Gorgofex
locations.description: Defeat The Forsaken, then interact with the remains to form Gorgofex.

locations.label: Gorgofex Corpsloder Upgrade Path
locations.description:
Upgrade for the Gorgofex wonder weapon. Two variants available: Corpsloder or Necrodystonia.
Talk to Blanchard, hit red button in Project Janus Reception, defend Klaus during lockdown.

locations.label: Gorgofex Necrodystonia Upgrade Path
locations.description:
Upgrade for the Gorgofex wonder weapon. Two variants available: Corpsloder or Necrodystonia.
Talk to Blanchard, get Strauss Counter, find Life Drain Serum, collect 3 additional items.

locations.label: Project Janus Brain
locations.description: Use Melee Macchiato to punch containment chamber in T1 Quantum Computing Core to reveal brain.

locations.label: Brain Containment Chamber
locations.description: Place brain in Project Janus containment chamber in T2 Teleportation Lab (left of Klaus).

locations.label: Boost & Quantum Vermin
locations.description: Hit red button on terminal in T2 Sublevel 10 to spawn blue Quantum Vermin. Kill with Gorgofex. Then interact with blue orb to charge the gorgofex.

locations.label: Portal Crystals
locations.description: Shoot charged Gorgofex at the crystals blocking the portal in T2 Teleportation Lab.

locations.label: Fungal Head
locations.description: Shoot charged Gorgofex shot at a body hanging from a balcony in Quantum Computing.

locations.label: Mop Bucket
locations.description: 1 of 2 locations. Move mop bucket under sprinkler, throw explosive at smoke detector to fill.

locations.label: Mop Bucket
locations.description: 1 of 2 locations. Move mop bucket under sprinkler, throw explosive at smoke detector to fill.

locations.label: Fungal Head Cleaning
locations.description: Use one of the filled mop buckets to clean the Fungal Head, then charge it with nearby kills. This reference area is not a separate guaranteed bucket spawn.

locations.label: Portal Preparation
locations.description: Place soul-charged Fungal Head in center of portal in T2 Teleportation Lab.

locations.label: Vacuum-Seal Device Container
locations.description: Blue Project Janus containers now open. Contains Vacuum-Seal Devices for capturing purple items.

locations.label: Portal Console
locations.description: Insert 4 captured items into console to power it and start a lockdown. There are approximately 10 floating purple objects around the map. Use Vacuum-Seal Devices to capture and return them here.

locations.label: Portal Lockdown Switches
locations.description: Teleportation Lab lockdown control area. The source provides one representative position; find and operate all required switches around the room.

locations.label: Portal to Boss Fight
locations.description:
A boss fight for this map, follow the main quest to begin.
Interact with portal after completing lockdown to enter final boss encounter area.

locations.label: Floor 1 - Boss Fight Decision
locations.description: Tower 3 first-vault reference area. Use the guide for the allegiance choice and ascent sequence; this marker does not identify the final rooftop boss arena.

locations.label: Floor 1 - L.T.G. Canister 1
locations.description: 1 of 3 L.T.G. Canisters in T3 Dark Aether Elements Vault 1. Kill zombies with purple eyes nearby.

locations.label: Floor 1 - L.T.G. Canister 2
locations.description: 1 of 3 L.T.G. Canisters in T3 Dark Aether Elements Vault 1. Kill zombies with purple eyes nearby.

locations.label: Floor 1 - L.T.G. Canister 3
locations.description: 1 of 3 L.T.G. Canisters in T3 Dark Aether Elements Vault 1. Kill zombies with purple eyes nearby.

locations.label: Floor 2 - Aether Crystals
locations.description: Shoot all Aether Crystals in T3 Dark Aether Elements Vault 2 to clear aether flow in pipes.

locations.label: Floor 2 - Aether Crystals
locations.description: Shoot all Aether Crystals in T3 Dark Aether Elements Vault 2 to clear aether flow in pipes.

targets.title: Accelerator power & moving Pack-a-Punch
targets.description: Executive Office snow globe → Sublevel 10 accelerator → break all crystals → Pack-a-Punch.

targets.title: Klaus arm reference & mop-bucket positions
targets.description: Save dropped Klaus arms; keep an explosive; plan Melee Macchiato and the spawn bucket.

targets.title: DNA vial fridge · Mutant Research
targets.description: Geneticist keycard → Test Area fridge DNA; take the Lab’s syringe.

targets.title: Syringe → blood sample → centrifuge
targets.description: Beam knocks body down → draw blood → Syringe back → defeat Fowler → special Injection.

targets.title: Bio Scanner door
targets.description: Fowler Injection at Containment scanner → access Teleportation Lab.

targets.title: Element clues & Bioweapons Lab keypads
targets.description: Deadshot initial + family-tank initial → element atomic number → three-digit keypad.

targets.title: Cyst & three Aetheric Flora sites
targets.description: Cyst absorbs 3 Vermin then 3 zombies → collect → drain 3 yellow Flora.

targets.title: Mapped power-surge computer & Forsaken panel
targets.description: Activate four surge terminals quickly → break Uber Klaus shoulders → lure onto energized panel.

targets.title: Gorgofex forge
targets.description: Defeat possessed robot and core → Cyst into orb → Gorgofex.

targets.title: Four Klaus-leg candidates
targets.description: Two robot arms + two Android Assembly legs → install on hanging Franken-Klaus.

targets.title: Klaus assembly → first terminal → trial
targets.description: Uber Klaus electricity → Franken-Klaus terminal → next round → finish S.A.M. trial → Teleportation Lab.

targets.title: S.A.M. file candidate positions
targets.description: Find four folders → sort dates oldest to newest → read their four file numbers.

targets.title: Teleportation Lab code terminal
targets.description: Enter chronological file code at Teleportation Lab computer.

targets.title: Quantum brain → containment chamber
targets.description: Melee Macchiato brain container → carry quickly to chamber beside Klaus.

targets.title: Quantum Vermin device → portal crystals
targets.description: Boost accelerator → Gorgofex kills on 5 Quantum Vermin → absorb orb → charged portal shot.

targets.title: Fungal Head & two mop-bucket positions
targets.description: Charged shot at Core wall opening → head → bucket under sprinkler → explosive smoke detector.

targets.title: Fungal Head charging area → portal
targets.description: Wash head → collect souls until purple → install in portal → confirm fungal growth.

targets.title: Vacuum device container & return console
targets.description: Janus containers → special devices → capture and collect 4 floating purple objects.

targets.title: Teleportation Lab console & switch area
targets.description: Insert 4 captures → start defense → turn each active red lever green until complete.

targets.title: Tower 3 portal
targets.description: Resupply before Tower 3. Help Richtofen → fight S.A.M.; help S.A.M. → fight Richtofen.

targets.title: Tower 3 · canisters & crystal-floor references
targets.description: Attune and choose → Vault 1 three soul canisters → Vault 2 all crystals → roof.

targets.title: Corpsloder upgrade reference
targets.description: C: Reception defense → 3 disabled-shaft buttons → Gorgofex blue-zombie kills → Panos.

targets.title: Necrodystonia upgrade reference
targets.description: N: Counter finds vial → charged shot; collect Hood, Fan and Tubing.
